population.survivorshipGap: Provider universe of today plus ended series; coverage of SEC 10-K filers 2000 14 %, 2010 22 %, 2020 48 % (protocol). Survivorship of issuers that vanished before universe formation is NOT measurable here; only the in-sample ended listings (V10 bounds) and the cap-weighted vs equal-weighted comparison are quantified.

returnBasis.spy: PRICE_RETURN (SPY split-adjusted close, same dates, no dividends)
returnBasis.totalReturn: only as labelled ESTIMATE in benchmark-reference-check.json

weighting: events: equal per event; funded: see A3
investmentAssumption: events: fully invested per event; funded strategy: slots of 1/N, unfilled slots in cash at 0 %; SPY: fully invested buy-and-hold
observedVsSecured: every cell reports the observed estimate and, separately, whether it is statistically secured (block bootstrap, Holm within the stated family)
deviations: DEVIATION_1: plausibility screen of PIT market caps added after the first run (cap weights were dominated by XBRL scale errors, e.g. ref_CB 1.8e16 USD 2010-06-25). Rule: cap > 5e12 USD or implied share count off by > 5x from the listing median -> excluded. Unscreened values are kept in capWeighted[*].unscreenedDeviationCheck.

DEVIATION_2: research-portfolio refuses inputs with listings x sessions > 2,000,000 (PORTFOLIO_OPERATION_BUDGET; N = 20 and 50 paths). Those paths use replicaLedger (same arithmetic); parity with the engine on all engine-feasible parity paths is reported (A3.replicaParity). The engine is unchanged.
NOTE: random tie-break paths at N=5/20/50 and the VOL_INVERSE/FULLY_INVESTED variants are attribution diagnostics, not candidates (no selection, R4).

A1_decomposition.definition: For each event e (signal week t, entry t+1, exit t+1+h): net_e = S_e + (P_t - S_e) + (g_e - P_t) - cost_e, with g_e gross price return, S_e SPY price return same dates, P_t equal-weighted mean gross return of ALL eligible completed frame observations of week t (incl. signal events; same entry/exit dates), cost_e = g_e - net_e. Event means are additive exactly. SPY excess (net) = (P - S) + (g - P) - cost.

ewIndexNote.definition: SPY over identical dates; population = weekly rebalanced equal-weighted frame index (mean weekly return of all listings observed in both consecutive calendar weeks with date >= listingStart), chained over identical dates; its difference to the buy-and-hold population mean is reported for the fixed horizons.
